body:
Split from #1295 (closed as superseded); this is the tracking issue for the reorganization. The approved tree, its naming sources and its placement rules are the [hierarchy comment on #1295](https://github.com/Agent-Field/CodeAF/issues/1295#issuecomment-5751311454).

Children:

- #1300 - search: space-key fix and the fzf v2 matcher (in flight)
- #1301 - one approval vocabulary across all five surfaces
- #1299 - keybindings: page-dependent ? overlay and customization
- #1302 - project-layer precedence and the badge/gate contradiction
- the re-tab itself, tracked here

## The shape

- Nine standard-named nodes, depth two: Models & Providers, Permissions, Budget, Context & Memory, Tasks, Workspace, Appearance, Connections, General. Subgroups only where scanning would fail (Permissions, Models & Providers, General); every other node flat.
- The panel opens on search; tabs become facets. Default view is the working set (about a dozen rows); every row stays reachable behind search and an all-rows toggle, with totality enforced by the chrome_test pattern that already fails the build when a registry key loses its tab.
- Presets as the first row of Permissions: safe / balanced / yolo writing the trust bundle (the models.crew word is the working precedent: one word writes five tier rows).
- The /autonomy rules live under Permissions as "Questions while you are away"; the ssh quartet moves to General > System; the countdowns inline under the rows they govern.

Evidence: audit-notes/settings-inventory.md (all 77 rows on this branch, 81 on dev, per-tab tables, the twelve label mismatches, and the naming collisions the re-tab dissolves) on feat/1089-custom-connections.

—
